Drawings, load-deflection data and interchange listings are issued per part on request. Tell us the part or the OE number and we will send what we hold.
What is the minimum order quantity for this part?

We supply in bulk. The minimum run is 10,000 pieces per part number, per compound, or quoted against the part where geometry or tooling makes that unrealistic. Prototype and first-article lots sit outside the minimum.
Can you match a competitor specification or reverse-engineer an existing part?

Yes. Send the old part or the OE number. We will produce a dimensioned drawing, confirm compound and bracket detail, and quote against it. A used bump stop has taken a set and measures short — we dimension to the original free height, not to the compressed sample.
What file formats do you accept for drawings?
PDF, DWG, DXF and STEP. A dimensioned 2D drawing with tolerances is enough to quote; a 3D model helps with tooling. If you only have the part, send the part — we will produce the drawing.
Do you provide material test reports with each shipment?

Yes. Material test reports, dimensional inspection sheets and a certificate of conformance ship with every consignment. Hardness, tensile to ASTM D412 and compression set to ASTM D395 Method B are tested in-house — on a load-bearing stop, compression set is the one to ask for.
What are your payment and delivery terms for international orders?
TT and LC accepted, discussed per order. Ex-works Nashik or FOB Nhava Sheva. Commercial invoice, packing list and certificate of origin are issued with every consignment.
